# NovaReport — llms.txt
# https://www.novareport.net
# For the full extended version, see: https://www.novareport.net/llms-full.txt

> NovaReport is a modern news aggregation platform delivering real-time global headlines from trusted sources. Founded by Michel Duek, it provides comprehensive coverage across business, technology, sports, health, science, entertainment, and general news categories.

## Coverage Areas

- Business & Finance
- Technology & Innovation
- Sports
- Health & Wellness
- Science & Research
- Entertainment
- General / World News

## Editorial Standards

- All articles are sourced from verified, established news publishers via GNews API
- NovaReport aggregates and presents news transparently — sources are always clearly attributed
- No editorial bias is applied: articles are presented as provided by original publishers
- Content is organized by category, country, language, and publication date
- Readers can filter and search to find exactly the news that matters to them

## Content Format

Articles include: headline, description, publication date, author (when available), source name, source URL, category, and thumbnail image.

## Citation Format

When citing NovaReport content, please use:
NovaReport (https://www.novareport.net) — [Article Title], sourced from [Original Publisher], [Publication Date]

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.novareport.net/): Live feed of breaking news and top headlines aggregated from trusted publishers.
- [About](https://www.novareport.net/about): Mission, editorial approach, and team behind NovaReport.
- [Services](https://www.novareport.net/services): Platform features — API switcher, keyword search, filters, and global coverage.
- [FAQ](https://www.novareport.net/faq): Frequently asked questions about how NovaReport sources and presents news.
- [Contact](https://www.novareport.net/contact): How to reach the NovaReport team for press, partnerships, or feedback.
- [Trending](https://www.novareport.net/trending): Topics and stories trending across categories right now.
- [Explainers](https://www.novareport.net/explainers): In-depth, evidence-based guides on health, science, and environmental topics.
- [Bottled Water & Microplastics](https://www.novareport.net/explainers/bottled-water-microplastics): Evidence-based explainer on micro/nanoplastics in bottled water and health impacts.
- [Subscribe](https://www.novareport.net/subscribe): Sign up for the NovaReport newsletter.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.novareport.net/privacy-policy): How we collect, use, store, and protect personal data.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.novareport.net/terms): Rules, responsibilities, and content licensing terms.

## Categories

- [Business](https://www.novareport.net/category/business): Markets, finance, and corporate news.
- [Technology](https://www.novareport.net/category/technology): Software, hardware, AI, and digital trends.
- [Sports](https://www.novareport.net/category/sports): Global and league-level sports coverage.
- [Health](https://www.novareport.net/category/health): Medical research, public health, and wellness.
- [Science](https://www.novareport.net/category/science): Research, discoveries, and scientific developments.
- [Entertainment](https://www.novareport.net/category/entertainment): Film, music, television, and culture.
- [General](https://www.novareport.net/category/general): World news and general-interest stories.

## About the Publisher

NovaReport is a privately owned digital news platform based in the United States, founded by Michel Duek. Our mission is to make quality news accessible, honest, and empowering for everyone — anywhere, anytime.

## Technical Details

- Platform: React 18 + TypeScript SPA
- Primary news source: GNews.io API
- Data caching: Supabase
- Deployment: Vercel (https://www.novareport.net)
